note: NR-417, NR-416, HARBOR and ORCHARD are authored examples. Runtime IDs/secrets must be composed from game state. Speaker provenance is private, not normal UI.

lines.text: Night operator, this is Mara. Keep the relay online. Check the work order before you touch a hatch.
Close the occupied side. Leave the clear side open. Both shutters down will drain the station.
If a call feels wrong, compare its order number. You can always ask for the current challenge.
A sweep buys twelve seconds on that side. Use the clear window to do the work.
Order NR-417. Sweep the left tunnel, then open the left hatch for the cartridge.
Order NR-416. Open the right hatch. We need to recover the line now.
lines.tell: Expired order NR-416 and wrong hatch; console requires NR-417 left.

lines.text: Order NR-417. Open the right hatch for the cartridge. I am waiting on your confirmation.
lines.tell: Current ID but wrong hatch; console requires left.

lines.text: Harbor. Read the order before you continue.
Orchard. There is no time to read it again.
lines.tell: Runtime response must differ from current private challenge.

lines.text: The right uplink is ready. Sweep that side, align the carrier, then transmit.
Take the quiet window. Check your panel. You have time to verify the next call.
Transmission received. Your shift is over. Leave the radio on the desk.
Station power depleted. Open both shutters to restore the line.
